candidate.blueprint_locator: Distribution of Content, printed p.5/PDF p.9; Management of Care, printed p.7/PDF p.11: coordinate care; legal rights/responsibilities; discharge planning; documentation and continuity
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — coordination, legal/ethical responsibilities, documentation and transitions
candidate.educational_objective: Apply the cited evidence to recognize the uniquely safest or most accurate nursing response in the clinical situation tested by V2-Q0124.

options.A: Delay assessment of post-hospital needs until a discharge date is fixed so the plan reflects only services that can be arranged on the final day.
options.B: Evaluate likely post-hospital service and self-care needs early enough to develop and implement a safe transition plan without unnecessary discharge delay.
options.C: Limit discharge planning to clients who personally request it because hospitals are not responsible for evaluating transition needs unless asked.
options.D: Complete discharge planning after the client leaves the hospital so community providers can determine which services are necessary and then notify the hospital.

candidate.rationale: CMS hospital discharge-planning requirements call for evaluation of the likelihood that a patient will need post-hospital services and the patient's capacity for self-care or care in the prior environment. The process must support an effective transition rather than being deferred until after discharge or restricted only to patient-requested planning.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Discharge planning evaluation includes likely post-hospital service needs and capacity for self-care or care in the prior environment.
candidate.source_locator: 42 CFR §482.43 — Discharge planning: evaluation of likely post-hospital service needs and capacity for self-care/care environment
candidate.stem: A hospitalized client will probably need home oxygen, medication teaching, and follow-up services after discharge. Which approach best reflects CMS discharge-planning requirements?
